Subject: Vendor onboarding: OptiScale payment terms & early-pay inquiry

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks for taking the call earlier. I wanted to follow up with the specifics so we can get OptiScale onto Redwood's vendor roster and align on payment terms. A few quick items: 

• We expect monthly invoices, typically Net45 based on contract milestones.
• For cashflow reasons, we’d like to explore an early-pay pilot for the first 2–3 invoices (pay within 10 days) in exchange for a small discount/fee.

Could you send over the vendor intake form and confirm whether Redwood requires a specific invoice header and PO number format? Also please let me know the preferred channels for W-9 and bank details (portal vs secure email).

We can provide:
- Completed onboarding spreadsheet
- W-9 (PDF)
- Sample invoices

Attachment: OptiScale-Company-Profile.pdf (1 page)

Thanks — looking to get this finalized quickly.

Oliver Tan

Hi Oliver —

Great to hear — we can move fast on this. Process overview and next steps below: 

1) Required items to create the vendor record in our AP system:
   - Completed vendor onboarding spreadsheet (see fields: legal name, EIN, remit-to address, ACH details)
   - W-9 (US vendors) or tax form equivalent
   - Bank details (ACH) and a voided check or bank letter
   - PO header preference and invoice sample (we standardize to PO-YYYY-#####)

2) For early-pay pilots: Finance evaluates requests case-by-case. Typical pilot structure is a short-term opt-in with an early-pay fee (1.5–3.0%), and we handle via an amendment to the Master Services Agreement plus a brief DocuSign addendum.

Please attach the W-9 and completed onboarding spreadsheet to this thread or upload them to the vendor portal (https://vendors.redwood.ai/upload). Once we have the paperwork, David will review the early-pay terms and get back with the proposed fee and any minimum invoice thresholds.

I’m attaching our onboarding checklist to speed things up.

Attachment: Vendor-Onboarding-Checklist.pdf

If you can get the files over today or tomorrow we’ll aim to get you live by next week.

Best,

Kimberly Park
Vendor Enablement Lead | Redwood Inference
